Technical_Architecture.text: Technical Architecture
System Overview
- The proposed system will consist of a multi-tier architecture, including presentation, application, and data layers.
- The system will be designed to support high availability and fault tolerance to ensure uninterrupted service.
Technology Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (React.js)
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js
- Database: MongoDB
- Cloud Platform: AWS (Amazon Web Services)
Security Architecture
- Implementation of 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) monitoring for real-time threat detection and response.
- Deployment of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system for log analysis and correlation.
- Incident response procedures to be in place with a target response time of 1 hour.
- Compliance with ISO 27001 standards for information security management.
System Requirements and Specifications
Functional Requirements
- User authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Data encryption at rest and in transit.
- Role-based access control for system users.
- Audit logging for all system activities.
Non-Functional Requirements
- System performance: Response time < 500ms under peak load.
- Scalability: Ability to handle a 20% increase in user traffic within 6 months.
- Availability: 99.9% uptime guarantee.
- Disaster recovery plan in place with regular backups and data replication.
Implementation Approach and Methodology
Agile Development Methodology
- Utilization of Scrum framework for iterative development and frequent releases.
- Continuous integration and deployment practices to ensure code quality and reliability.
- Regular sprint reviews with stakeholders for feedback and validation.
Integration Requirements
- Integration with existing LDAP directory service for user management.
- API integration with third-party services for data exchange.
- Webhooks for real-time notifications and event-driven architecture.
Scalability and Performance Considerations
Scalability
- Horizontal scaling of application servers to handle increased user load.
- Database sharding for distributed data storage and retrieval.
- Load balancing to distribute traffic evenly across servers.
Performance
- Caching mechanisms for frequently accessed data.
- Query optimization and indexing for efficient database operations.
- Monitoring tools for performance metrics and proactive tuning.
Technical Standards and Compliance
Industry Standards
- Adherence to OWASP (Open Web Application Security Project) guidelines for secure coding practices.
- Compliance with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) for data privacy and protection.
- Regular security audits and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities.
